attributes.description: NOCIL Ltd., incorporated in 1961, manufactures rubber chemicals which are used by the tyre industry and other rubber processing industries.[1] It is a part of Arvind Mafatlal Group and is the Largest Rubber Chemicals Manufacturer in India.
